card.name: Number before a hyphenated unit
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number after "a" or "the" when a hyphen and a unit follow, as in "24-hour period" or "21-day cycle". The unit is usually hours, days, inches, gauge or mg.

modes.label: Time spans
modes.description: Digits of a duration before -hour or -day, such as a dosing period or treatment cycle.
modes.example: Do not exceed 140 mg in a 2<<4>>-hour period.

modes.label: Size or strength
modes.description: Digits of a measurement before a hyphenated unit such as -inch, -gauge, -mg or -horsepower.
modes.example: replace the needle with a new 2<<6>>-gauge, ½-inch needle.

card.writes: It promotes hyphenated compound endings like -second, -size and -time, and suppresses unhyphenated unit words like hour, day and inch.
card.plain: It fires on a number that is about to be joined by a hyphen to a unit, as in "24-hour" or "21-day".
